objective: Execute Phase 10 independent premium release certification across all quality gates (Gameplay, Visual, Political Comedy, Performance, UX, Maintainability, and Final Verdict)
acceptance_criteria: Ground on clean commit b430e74 without assumptions
Gate A: Verify gameplay correctness across 3-lane movement, jumps, slides, trains, rooftop traversal, collisions, powerups, deterministic solvability in browser
Gate B: Audit visual quality across all registered worlds (especially Mitron Express and Rahulverse) with captured evidence across initial, mid, landmark, high-speed, mobile, and character views
Gate C: Verify physical comedy sequences for both political worlds (setup, performance, payoff, visibility, restart, collision)
Gate D: Measure real frame times, draw calls, stutter, heap memory, and stability over repeated restarts and world switching
Gate E: Audit player experience across first-run, touch/keyboard, modals, audio, accessibility, and save integrity
Gate F: Audit maintainability, event lifecycles, and architecture boundaries
Gate G: Classify all findings (P0/P1/P2) and issue definitive release verdict (RC Accepted, External Playtest Only, or Release Blocked) with comprehensive release report
non_goals: Do not add broad new features or speculative architecture rewrites
Do not fabricate tester quotes or claimed hardware performance
Do not bypass or modify authoritative collision dimensions
